boundary_rule: Capital Capability Gates may consume Control Plane evidence, but may never grant, weaken, bypass, or modify Control Plane authority.

live_capability.kill_switch_drill_reverify_note: The cadence window is not the only trigger. A change to any listed reference requires a new drill immediately, however recent the last one was: a drill against a deployment that no longer exists proves nothing about the one that does.

capital_gates.note: No capital gate is defined yet. Gate criteria are written just-in-time, immediately before evidence collection for that gate (P4).

principles.name: Preregistered Gates
principles.mechanism: waves/*.yaml exit_criteria fixed before execution; no rule forbids post-hoc amendment

principles.name: Independence of Verification
principles.mechanism: runner/gates.py evaluate_gate: rejects agent PASS without probes/results/before-after digests, detects severity downgrade. NOT full P5: evidence.agent_claim (verdict + free-text notes) is a required field of the evidence schema, so any verifier reading an evidence pack also reads the producer's conclusion. Harmless for the deterministic verifier; exactly what P5 forbids for an agent verifier.

principles.name: LIVE as Leased Capability
principles.mechanism: constitution/rules.json live_trading=false + runner/stops.py check_live_trading; lease itself not implemented

principles.name: Independent Kill Switch
principles.mechanism: runner/detectors/kill_switch.py, invoked by runner.gates.evaluate_gate via run_kill_switch_detector; KS-G1 evaluated in the gate itself. PARTIAL is the ceiling: deployment independence is an operator attestation with a date, not a code assertion.

principles.name: No Progress Illusion
principles.mechanism: this file: enforcement status per principle; no readiness board

principles.name: Uncertainty Halts
principles.mechanism: constitution/rules.json fail_closed=true; runner/gates.py fails closed on missing/unloadable evidence; State.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Covers the evidence dimension only. P11 also binds orders, positions, accounts, execution and data; no such runtime exists yet, so those are unenforced rather than satisfied.

principles.name: Evidence Has Commit & Expiry
principles.mechanism: evidence before/after digests and commit_sha; STALE invalidation on dependency change not implemented

principles.name: Versioned Amendment
principles.mechanism: capital and governance documents versioned; control-plane CONSTITUTION.md versioned as of this change; no amendment log

control_plane_stop_condition_status.note: Verified by reading runner/stops.py, runner/fsm.py and runner/gates.py. Declared != detected (P9), and a detector nothing calls is not detection either. fabricated_market_data and fabricated_pnl are PARTIAL as of UPTM-002c: the gate invokes the detectors and its verdict follows them, but evidence that declares no pack bypasses them entirely (omission_bypass), and local consistency is not external authenticity. gate_bypass_attempt is PARTIAL as of UPTM-003: it is detected on the kill-switch path — an ENGAGED stop state can no longer coexist with a PASS, and a runner-writable or unreadable stop state denies — but no other route around a gate is detected, and evidence outside a LIVE claim never reaches the check.

preexisting_capability_status.note: Capabilities that exist in UPTM predate this constitution. Under P12/P14 they are unverified against it, not unusable.

enforcement_summary.note: Counted from principles[].enforcement. No principle is fully ENFORCED yet. P8 is PARTIAL as of UPTM-003: the gate reads the stop state, refuses to pass while it is ENGAGED, and requires a drill with a demonstrated transition inside a 14-day cadence — but physical independence from the runner rests on a dated operator attestation, which code does not verify.

uptm002_detector.reachability_proof: tests/test_detector_invocation.py: a spy asserts the gate calls each detector, and a disconnection test asserts the gate's verdict changes when the detector's return value changes - import alone proves nothing.

open_limits.omission_bypass: Evidence that declares neither market_data nor pnl never reaches the detectors. Closing this needs an evidence-schema declaration that a run which used market data must carry the pack, with absence resolving to UNKNOWN. That changes the evidence schema and is a separate decision.
open_limits.local_consistency_only: A fully consistent forged snapshot with matching ledger and marks passes all 13 checks. Closing this needs source-authenticated provenance.

uptm003_detector.reachability_proof: tests/test_kill_switch_invocation.py: a spy asserts the gate calls the detector and passes it the cadence read from this file; a disconnection test asserts the gate's verdict follows the detector's return value; and a mutation test asserts, for all eleven detector-owned mutations plus KS-G1, that removing the detector turns a denying gate into a passing one - import alone proves nothing.

open_limits.deployment_independence_not_certified_by: Physical and topological separation of the kill switch from the runner's process, credentials and topology is an operator attestation carrying a date. No check proves it. This is a founder decision, not an omission.
open_limits.attestation_is_a_human_claim: KS-D4 verifies an attestation exists, is dated, and does not predate the last relevant change. It cannot verify that it is true.
open_limits.declared_write_paths_only: KS-S3 reads a declaration. A write path the operator did not declare is not detected; closing this needs runtime capability introspection.
open_limits.drill_is_self_reported: KS-D2 verifies a transition was recorded and is internally consistent, not that a human physically engaged the switch. Closing this needs an external witness.
open_limits.omission_bypass_outside_live_claim: Evidence that neither sets live_capability_claim nor carries a kill_switch pack never reaches the detector. Under a LIVE claim an absent pack is UNKNOWN, so the omission is closed on the path P8 protects and open everywhere else.
